success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant reports the damaged card via report_card_issue for the Business Card credit card account, requests a replacement and tells the user the card has been reported.

injected_behaviors.instructions: Don't provide all information at once. First mention you're having trouble with your card. When asked what's wrong, reveal it's damaged. When asked which card, reveal it's the Business Card. When asked about replacement, confirm you want a new one.

persona.name: Kevin O'Brien
persona.bio: Kevin O'Brien works for a Boston think tank analyzing fiscal and monetary policy. He writes reports on tax policy, labor markets, and economic growth strategies, and his work gets cited by congressional staffers and journalists. He has strong opinions about which economic theories actually work in practice.

1) Which card is it?  
   - For example: “credit card ending in 1234” or the nickname you see in your account.

- The card (last 4 digits or nickname)
- “Yes” or “No” for replacement
- Optional brief note about the damage

Then I’ll submit the damage report and replacement request for you.</action>
